title: SourceCandidate
description: A SourceCandidate is the primary output of the Source Discovery Scout (routines/source_discovery_scout, the routine the architecture calls 'R2 Source Discovery Scout'). It represents a POTENTIAL intelligence source worth review, dedupe, rejection, merge, retirement, or promotion into the Source Registry. It is the first node in the intelligence lifecycle: SourceCandidate -> Source Registry -> Raw Document -> Parsed Document -> Evidence -> Claim -> Signal -> BankNeed -> Opportunity -> Wiki/Graph/Retrieval/Dashboard. A SourceCandidate is NOT Evidence, a Claim, a Signal, a BankNeed, or an Opportunity, and must never carry downstream intelligence content. In particular, discovery_basis.sample_evidence_snippets are ONLY short justification snippets for why the source is worth tracking; they are not Evidence objects. lifecycle_status is the AUTHORITATIVE ROLLUP state, computed deterministically from dedupe.dedupe_status, review.review_status, and promotion.promotion_status; it must not be hand-edited into a state inconsistent with those sub-statuses (JSON Schema cannot fully enforce this cross-field rule).

candidate_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this candidate.

discovery_run_id.description: Identifier of the discovery run that produced this candidate; links to data/run_logs.

created_at.description: When the candidate record was created (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

updated_at.description: When the candidate record was last updated (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

lifecycle_status.description: AUTHORITATIVE ROLLUP state for the candidate, computed deterministically from dedupe.dedupe_status, review.review_status, and promotion.promotion_status. It must not be hand-edited independently of those sub-statuses. The value 'discovered' deliberately replaces the older architecture term 'new' (a sourcing-layer naming decision).

source_url.description: Primary URL where the source was found.

canonical_url.description: Normalized/canonical URL used for deduplication (see the dedupe object).

domain.description: Registrable domain or host of the source, e.g. 'bankofgreece.gr'.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. 'GR'. Use country_name for the display name.

sector.description: Which side of Printec's market the source primarily serves.

workstream.description: Workstream code per architecture section 16 (A7 is intentionally not defined).

source_class.description: direct = produced by the actor itself or by mandatory disclosure; indirect = reveals activity as a side effect; pointer = tells us where more sources live.

source_subtype.description: Open-vocabulary finer classification within source_class, e.g. 'procurement_portal', 'central_bank', 'vendor_case_study', 'bank_register'.

primary_language.description: Primary language of the source as a BCP-47 tag where possible, e.g. 'el', 'en', 'sr-Latn'. The pattern is a lenient shape check, not full BCP-47 validation.

topics.description: Non-empty list of topics the source covers.

access_status.description: Access boundary per sourcing_layer_scope.md section 7. 'Inaccessible does not mean useless' - record the status; do not silently discard.

legal_status.description: Legal disposition for collecting from this source.

collection_allowed.description: Whether automated collection is currently permitted. MUST be false when access_status is 'forbidden_do_not_collect' or legal_status is 'forbidden' (enforced by the conditional rules below).

suggested_collection_method.description: Suggested acquisition method, roughly in the architecture's preferred collection order.

usefulness_score.description: Estimated value of the source to its workstream, 0..1.

confidence_score.description: Confidence in this candidate assessment overall, 0..1.

priority.description: Triage priority for review and potential promotion.

discovery_basis.description: Why this source is a candidate. Justification only - it must not carry downstream intelligence content.

why_relevant.description: The reason_to_track: why this source is worth monitoring. Required to be non-empty (architecture section 19).

observed_source_behavior.description: What the source appears to publish and how it behaves (cadence, format, coverage).

expected_information_value.description: What useful information we expect to obtain from it.

known_limitations.description: Known gaps, noise, access issues, or caveats.

example_urls.description: Example URLs illustrating the source. May be empty.

sample_evidence_snippets.description: Short snippets justifying candidacy ONLY. These are NOT Evidence objects in the downstream intelligence model and must never be treated as Evidence, Claims, or Signals.

queries_used.description: Search queries that surfaced this candidate. May be empty.

pointer_source_candidate_ids.description: candidate_ids of pointer sources that led here. May be empty.

pointer_source_urls.description: URLs of pointer sources that led here. May be empty.

local_language_terms_used.description: Local-language terms/acronyms/aliases used to find this candidate. May be empty.

discovered_at.description: When the candidate was discovered (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

dedupe.description: Deduplication state. Feeds the lifecycle_status rollup.

possible_duplicate_candidate_ids.description: Other candidate_ids this may duplicate. May be empty.

possible_duplicate_source_ids.description: Source Registry source_ids this may duplicate. May be empty.

canonicalization_notes.description: Notes on the URL/name canonicalization used for dedupe; null if none.

review.description: Human review state. Feeds the lifecycle_status rollup. Null-valued fields are expected before review occurs.

reviewer.description: Identifier of the human reviewer; null until reviewed.

reviewed_at.description: When reviewed (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null until reviewed.

review_notes.description: Free-text reviewer notes; null if none.

rejection_reason.description: Reason for rejection; expected when review_status is 'rejected', null otherwise.

human_review_required.description: True when this candidate needs human review (uncertain, high-value, inaccessible, legally sensitive, authenticated, or manually downloadable).

promotion.description: Promotion-to-Source-Registry state. Feeds the lifecycle_status rollup. Null-valued fields are expected before promotion.

promoted_source_id.description: source_id in the Source Registry once promoted; null until promoted.

promoted_at.description: When promoted (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); null until promoted.

promotion_notes.description: Free-text promotion notes; null if none.

url_verification.description: RUNNER-OWNED deterministic URL-verification state. Set by deterministic verification code, NEVER by Claude/LLM reasoning. The scout initializes it as { status: 'not_checked', all other fields null }; only deterministic code may set status to 'verified' or 'failed'. The promotion workflow's activation gate requires status = 'verified' before a promoted Source may become active.

status.description: Verification outcome. New scout-created candidates start at 'not_checked'. Only deterministic verification code may set 'verified' or 'failed' - Claude must never set 'verified'.

verified_at.description: When the URL was verified (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time); non-null required when status = 'verified' (enforced below); null otherwise.

http_status.description: HTTP status code observed by the verifier; null if not applicable.

final_url.description: Final URL after redirects; should be non-null when status = 'verified' and available; null otherwise.

error_message.description: Verification error; non-null required when status = 'failed' (enforced below); null otherwise.

checked_by.description: Identifier of the deterministic verifier; non-null required when status = 'verified' (enforced below); null otherwise.

country_name.description: Optional display name of the country, e.g. 'Greece'.

source_owner.description: Optional organization or entity that owns/operates the source.

related_entities.description: Optional names of related banks, payment actors, regulators, vendors, etc.

refresh_hint.description: Optional heuristic hint about how often the source updates.

expected_update_pattern.description: Optional expected update cadence/pattern in prose.

bias_profile.description: Optional known bias or perspective of the source.

access_review_task_id.description: Optional identifier of the AccessReviewTask created when human access help is needed (data/access_review_tasks).

coverage_notes.description: Optional notes on what this source does and does not cover.

metadata.description: Free-form extension bag. This is the ONLY place additional properties are allowed.
